lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Joggle bend 2: 90 deg fold from the step into lower wall 10/11. It is a real formed fold with both lower-wall skins visible, and the extent matches the lower wall (a -105.9..84.4). The step top / outer arc is mostly unscanned. In the 25/50/75% sections the inner-skin apex sits 1.3-1.4 mm inward of the line, so with t = 1.92 the outer apex should be about 0.55-0.6 mm outward. The sparse scanned outer points in the bisector band agree, at +0.3..+0.76 mm. The line is therefore about 0.5 mm inside the sheet: parallel and under the 1 mm threshold, so OK. The labeler's 'uncertain' flag is still reasonable because the outer arc is largely occluded.
